jobs.title: Senior Director, POM Product Management Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description

We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Senior Director, POM Product Manager to join our AI Hub team. This is a strategic product leadership opportunity for an experienced product leader who can define vision, drive execution across complex initiatives, and shape AI-powered capabilities that improve how developers, designers, and builders work across the firm.

In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:

Drive product discovery, requirements definition, and execution discipline across the product lifecycle, while helping strengthen product practices and operating rigor across the AI Hub.
Lead product strategy for large and/or complex AI-powered capabilities within Eliza, our central AI platform, with ownership of core product areas that support developers, designers, and builders.
Define product vision, roadmap, prioritization, and execution plans for assigned domains, ensuring alignment with business goals, user needs, and platform objectives.
Serve as a thought leader and subject matter expert within the product management team and across the organization, influencing product direction for innovative and business-critical capabilities.
Collaborate closely with engineering, design, and cross-functional stakeholders to drive delivery, resolve tradeoffs, and translate complex technical opportunities into clear product plans and measurable outcomes.
Lead product launch, adoption, and enablement planning for major releases, ensuring strong operational execution and sustained impact.

To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:

Bachelors degree in a technical related field, Engineering or CS degree, or equivalent work experience required
Proven experience, preferably 15+ years, in product management, including building and scaling technical products from ideation and discovery through launch, adoption, and ongoing enhancement.
Deep knowledge of technical product management, modern AI systems, and product strategies that support the software development lifecycle, internal platforms, and enterprise user experiences.
Strong understanding of the AI ecosystem, including model providers, enterprise AI platforms, and how AI products integrate into engineering workflows, developer tooling, and operational processes.
Experience leading complex product areas in close partnership with engineering and design teams, with the ability to translate technical concepts into clear strategy, roadmaps, priorities, and execution plans.
Strong stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills, with experience operating effectively across a matrixed organization; familiarity with language model training, fine tuning, evaluation, or governance workflows is a plus

About Us

At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting-edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide.

Recognized as a top destination for innovators, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary.

About The Team

At BNY, our culture speaks for itself, check out the latest BNY news at BNY Newsroom & BNY LinkedIn

Here’s a Few Of Our Recent Awards

America’s Most Innovative Companies, Fortune, 2025
World’s Most Admired Companies, Fortune 2025
“Most Just Companies”, Just Capital and CNBC, 2025

Our Benefits And Rewards

BNY offers highly competitive compensation, benefits, and wellbeing programs rooted in a strong culture of excellence and our pay-for-performance philosophy. We provide access to flexible global resources and tools for your life’s journey. Focus on your health, foster your personal resilience, and reach your financial goals as a valued member of our team, along with generous paid leaves, including paid volunteer time, that can support you and your family through moments that matter.

BNY is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer - Underrepresented racial and ethnic groups/Females/Individuals with Disabilities/Protected Veterans.

jobs.title: Director, Product Design
jobs.description:
🚀 Join the Future of Commerce with Whatnot!

Whatnot is the largest live shopping platform in North America and Europe to buy, sell, and discover the things you love. Whether it's trading cards, fashion, electronics, or live plants, our sellers are building real businesses across hundreds of categories. We're building live commerce at a scale that's never been done in the West, and there's no playbook to copy. The people here are shaping how an entirely new industry develops.

As a remote co-located team, we're inspired by our values and anchored in hubs across the US, UK, Ireland, Poland, Germany, and Australia. We move fast, stay close to our users, and focus on the work that drives the most impact.

We're one of the fastest growing marketplaces and were recently named the #1 Best Startup Employer in America by Forbes. Check out the latest Whatnot updates on our news and engineering blogs and join us as we enable anyone to turn their passion into a business and bring people together through commerce.

About The Role

We’re looking for a strategic and inspiring Director of Product Design to lead our Buyer Design team, the group responsible for shaping the end-to-end experience for millions of users navigating our platform.

As the design leader overseeing the entire buyer journey, you'll drive the strategy and execution for everything from customer acquisition, activation, to retention and re-engagement. This includes onboarding, discovery surfaces (browse, search, ranking, personalization, taxonomy), the live shopping experience, customer service, our games team, and customer service flows.

You’ll be a true player-coach, equally comfortable building and developing a high-performing design team as you are rolling up your sleeves and doing the work yourself. You’ll help shape the team, establish clear career paths, mentor designers, and create an environment where people can grow and do their best work.

As a leader, you’ll help define the design strategy and set a clear vision for what our experiences can become, partnering closely with product, engineering, research, and business teams to turn that vision into a roadmap for the team.

As a practitioner, you’ll stay close to the work. You’ll move fluidly from defining the long-term experience vision to tackling specific product and feature-level design challenges - exploring concepts, prototyping ideas, and helping bring the details to life. This role is for someone who can lead through both direction and craft, knowing when to empower the team and when to jump in and design alongside them.

What You'll Do

Lead and scale a high-performing team of product designers across the buyer funnel.
Define and drive the vision, strategy, and execution for the buyer experience in collaboration with cross-functional partners.
Partner with research, data, and product to develop deep customer empathy and inform high-impact design decisions.
Shape intuitive, elegant systems across discovery, live shopping, and post-purchase experiences.
Ensure our experiences are accessible, inclusive, and delightfully human.
Champion design quality and consistency across surfaces while enabling speed and iteration.
Nurture a strong design culture through mentorship, feedback, and high standards for craft and thinking.
Represent design in executive conversations and influence company-wide priorities.

What We’re Looking For

10+ years of product design experience, with at least 3+ years leading teams.
A player-coach mindset-excited to mentor, but equally passionate about designing and solving problems hands-on.
Strong portfolio showcasing interaction and visual design skills, with a track record of shipping successful products.
Proven success designing and scaling customer-facing experiences across a complex funnel (acquisition through retention).
Deep expertise in interaction design, systems thinking, and user-centered design.
Strong understanding of search, discovery, personalization, and taxonomy design principles.
Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, or live shopping platforms is a major plus.
A strong collaborator who thrives at the intersection of product, business, and user needs.
A portfolio that demonstrates thoughtful, elegant solutions to complex problems.

Why You’ll Love This Role

You’ll help define how the next generation of users discover, shop, and engage with sellers and communities they love. You’ll work alongside a passionate and ambitious team that values joy, experimentation, and deep customer empathy. And you’ll help build a design culture where creativity and performance go hand in hand.

If you’re an experienced design leader who loves craft, strategy, and collaboration, we’d love to hear from you!

Reporting Structure

Jon Malkemus - VP of Design

Please note: Whatnot will only contact you through official @whatnot.com email addresses. If you see an email impersonating a Whatnot recruiter, please disregard and report it as spam.

💛 EOE

Whatnot is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diversity, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, parental status, disability status, or any other status protected by local law. We believe that our work is better and our company culture is improved when we encourage, support, and respect the different skills and experiences represented within our workforce.

Compensation Range: $310K - $365K

jobs.title: Vice President, Global Product Strategy
jobs.description:
Position Overview:
A senior management role responsible for the company's global product strategy, product portfolio planning, and long-term product growth direction. This position typically reports to the CEO, President, or Chief Product Officer (CPO) and serves as a bridge between various departments, including marketing, customers, product, technology, sales, operations, and finance/investment.

Core Responsibilities
Global Product Strategy
Formulate the company's global product strategy and medium-to-long-term product development roadmaps.
Determine product direction based on global market trends, customer needs, and the competitive landscape.
Establish product strategies tailored to different regions and customer segments.
Product Portfolio Management
Manage the company's overall product portfolio; identify key products, growth products, and strategic products.
Evaluate product lifecycles, market potential, and business value.
Determine strategic directions regarding product entry, expansion, upgrades, or exit.
Market and Competitive Analysis
Continuously research global markets, industry trends, and competitors.
Analyze customer needs, pricing dynamics, market size, and growth opportunities.
Translate market insights into product strategies and business opportunities.
Product Roadmap
Develop annual and multi-year product roadmaps.
Determine priorities for product development, resource allocation, and go-to-market timing.
Coordinate R&D, engineering, design, marketing, and sales teams to execute the strategy.
Global Market Expansion
Participate in product planning for new markets, countries, and business areas.
Formulate localized product strategies based on specific market characteristics.
Support the company's internationalization and global business growth.
Cross-functional Leadership
Collaborate with the CEO, CPO, CTO, CMO, CFO, COO, and regional leaders.
Coordinate resources across product, technology, sales, marketing, operations, and finance functions.
Drive the execution of company-wide strategic initiatives.
Commercialization and Growth
Participate in defining product pricing, business models, and revenue growth strategies.
Identify new revenue streams for products.
Enhance market penetration, customer retention, and product profitability.
Strategic Partnerships and M&A
Evaluate potential partners, technical collaborations, and strategic alliances.
Participate in product-related investment, M&A, and integration projects as necessary.
Assess whether external technologies, products, or companies align with the corporate strategy.
Qualifications
Over 20 years of experience in product management, strategy, business development, or related fields.
Over 8 years of experience in senior management or cross-functional leadership roles. Possesses work experience in global markets or multinational corporations.
Familiar with product strategy, market analysis, business models, and product lifecycle management.
Demonstrates strong capabilities in data analysis, business judgment, and strategic planning.
Capable of communicating at a strategic level with the CEO, the Board of Directors, and senior management.
Possesses excellent cross-functional coordination, negotiation, and leadership skills.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Product Telemetry & Analytics
jobs.description:
Meet the Moment with Alteryx

We're living through a once-in-a-generation shift in how work gets done. Data, automation, and AI are quickly becoming the center of every business decision - and Alteryx is leading the transformation.

You'll be working on the challenges that sit at the heart of modern business. No matter your role, the work you do will help organizations move faster, see more clearly, and tackle questions that used to feel impossible.

If you're ready to meet the moment with innovation, curiosity, and excellence, there's a place for you here.

We are hiring a Senior Manager, Product Telemetry & Analytics to lead the team behind how Alteryx understands product usage and customer behavior. Our telemetry function has grown from supporting Product to supporting the company: Finance, Customer Success, Rev Ops, and Sales all depend on this data to make decisions.

You will lead a team based in India that owns instrumentation, the semantic layer, and the self-serve analytics platform that makes product data available across the business. You are accountable for how the function runs: prioritization and capacity, enablement and adoption, team visibility, and talent development.

This role is based on the East Coast to maximize overlap with the team's working hours and reports to the Sr. Director, Customer Signals.

What You'll Do

Own a single intake path for telemetry and analytics requests across Product, Finance, CS, Rev Ops, and IT, balancing planned platform work against urgent executive asks
Partner with technical leadership on feasibility, dependency order, and sequencing
Build enablement into a standing program so each function can find, understand, and trust the data on its own, and grow the share of demand served through self-serve
Govern metric definitions so the same number means the same thing in every forum
Own how the function is represented to leadership: what is shipping, what is blocked, what changed, and what it means, with recommendations rather than status
Lead and develop a team based in India, including talent assessment, performance, career paths, and the skills the function needs as it becomes more AI-native

Success in This Role

The organization self-serves a growing share of its telemetry and analytics needs each quarter
Platform and foundation work advances predictably rather than losing to whoever asked most recently
Leadership knows what the team is working on, what is coming, and what is not yet covered, without asking
Stakeholders trust the numbers, because definitions are aligned and governed
The team grows in strategic capability, and no single person becomes a bottleneck

Who You Are

8+ years in product telemetry, product analytics, analytics engineering, or data roles, including at least 3 years managing a team
Demonstrated ownership of an analytics or data operating model: intake, prioritization, capacity planning, and service expectations
Experience building self-service analytics or internal data products that teams could find, understand, and trust
Track record of executive communication: setting expectations, framing tradeoffs, and earning trust with senior stakeholders
Fluent enough in both product analytics and data architecture to be credible in either conversation, without needing to be the expert in the room
Experience leading a team based outside the U.S., ideally in India, across a significant time zone difference

Bonus Points

Experience with AI-native or agent-queryable data infrastructure
Familiarity with Snowflake, Amplitude, or comparable warehouse and behavioral analytics platforms
Experience in enterprise software with a complex user journey, or in PLG and product adoption environments
Hands-on background in SQL, dbt, or pipeline work, even if not current
Experience working alongside UX research, VOC, or experience measurement functions

Compensation

Alteryx is committed to fair, equitable, and transparent compensation. Final compensation is determined by several factors, including but not limited to relevant work experience, education, certifications, skills, and geographic location.

The base salary range for this role in the United States is $183,125 to $200,450.

This role is also eligible for a target annual bonus of 15% of base salary, based on individual and company performance.

In addition to base pay and bonus eligibility, this role includes clear forms of additional compensation, such as:

A monthly Connectivity Plus stipend of $150 to support remote work-related expenses
An annual $200 home office reimbursement

Alteryx offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial security, and overall well-being, including:

Medical, dental, and vision coverage
401(k) with company match
Paid parental leave, caregiver leave, and flexible time off
Mental health support and wellness reimbursement
Career development and education assistance

jobs.title: Director, Product Management - Data Platform
jobs.description:
Summary

The Basics:

Our Product Management team is actively seeking a new Director of Product Management focused on Data Platform, Cloud, and SaaS Architecture
to join our passionate, driven, and fast-paced team. In this role, you will own and shape Tanium’s end-to-end data strategy across cloud and SaaS environments, partnering closely with engineering, product, design, and cross-functional leadership to define how Tanium stores, accesses, queries, moves, and visualizes data across the platform.

You will bring deep experience in cloud and SaaS architectures, data platforms, and enterprise-scale systems, with the ability to translate complex customer, product, and technical requirements into actionable strategy and execution. You will need to be successful influencing cross-functionally across all levels of the organization, operating horizontally across multiple teams and pods, and drive clarity in ambiguous, complex technical domains. You must also be comfortable setting strategic direction while staying close enough to the work to make high-quality product and architecture decisions.

This is an individual contributor role.

Responsibilities

Own the product strategy and roadmap for Tanium’s cloud/SaaS data platform, from ideation through launch, in close partnership with engineering teams.
Define and drive the short- and long-term roadmap for Tanium’s end-to-end data architecture, including storage, access, query, visualization, and data movement capabilities.
Partner with Product Managers, Engineering, Design, and leadership across the organization to align priorities across multiple pods and ensure teams are building toward a cohesive data strategy.
Lead product direction for how data is surfaced and experienced in Atlas and the UI, with a focus on improving trust, usability, reliability, and customer value.
Drive the strategy for data movement and integration capabilities, including export, import, and scalable data exchange patterns across products and use cases.
Establish clear product requirements, technical specifications, use cases, business logic, and success metrics for data platform capabilities.
Partner with engineering leadership to make durable architectural decisions across complex, distributed cloud and SaaS systems.
Champion data quality as a core product priority, setting expectations and mechanisms to improve consistency, reliability, and trust throughout the data lifecycle.
Collaborate with internal teams on enablement, training, and launch materials to ensure successful adoption of new data capabilities and platform improvements.
Work closely with business, technical, customer-facing, and go-to-market teams to understand customer needs, solve daily challenges, and identify opportunities for product differentiation.
Leverage innovation and trends in cloud, SaaS, data architecture, analytics, and enterprise platform technologies to develop strategic solutions.

Requirements

Education

BA/BS required
MA/MS or equivalent advanced technical/business degree preferred

Experience

8+ years of total professional experience in enterprise B2B software, with at least 5 years in product management supporting a SaaS, cloud platform, data platform, infrastructure, or security technology product.
Proven experience leading product strategy for complex technical platforms, including the ability to define opportunities, translate customer needs into requirements, and deliver products at enterprise scale.
Deep experience with cloud and SaaS architectures, with strong working knowledge of hyperscaler environments such as Azure and/or AWS.
Strong data platform experience, including one or more of the following:
Data storage and data access architectures
Query layers and large-scale database systems
Data visualization and analytics experiences
Data movement, export/import, integration, or interoperability capabilities
Data quality, reliability, governance, and lifecycle considerations

Experience working across distributed systems and multiple product surfaces, rather than a single narrowly defined application or monolith.
Experience with large-scale enterprise data systems; experience with graph databases is a plus.
Strong track record of working with engineering and business stakeholders to drive product definition, strategic alignment, prioritization, and execution.
Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, quickly ramp into new technical domains, and bring structure to broad, evolving problem spaces.
Proven ability to influence horizontally across cross-functional teams, product pods, and senior stakeholders.
Technology background preferred, ideally with experience in security, systems management, IT operations, cloud infrastructure, data platforms, or enterprise platform products.

Nice to have

Experience with graph databases or graph-based data models.
Experience with large-scale database systems, analytics platforms, or enterprise data visualization products.
Broader hyperscaler depth across Azure, AWS, and/or other cloud providers.
Experience building durable export/import patterns and integrations across complex enterprise products.
Experience leading product teams through organizational growth, hiring, or team structure evolution.

About Tanium

Tanium is the Autonomous IT company. As Al accelerates both innovation and risk, Tanium Atlas, the company's autonomous operating system, puts the full depth of the Tanium Autonomous IT Platform behind every IT and security operator - human and agentic. Tanium provides the real-time intelligence, agentic decision-making, and autonomous execution operators needed to detect, decide, and remediate at machine speed across their endpoint estate.

The company is recognized as a Leader in the inaugural 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Endpoint Management Tools, as a Leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Client Endpoint Management Software for Windows Device Management 2025-2026 Vendor Assessment, and as a Leader in The Forrester Wave™. Endpoint Management Platforms, Q2 2026.

To learn how Tanium delivers Autonomous IT for unstoppable business, visit www.tanium.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

On a mission. Together.

At Tanium, we are stewards of a culture that emphasizes the importance of collaboration, respect, and diversity. In our pursuit of revolutionizing the way some of the largest enterprises and governments in the world solve their most difficult IT challenges, we are strengthened by our unique perspectives and by our collective actions.

As a global organization with stakeholders around the world, it’s imperative that the diversity of our customers and communities is reflected internally in our team members. We strive to create a diverse and inclusive environment where everyone feels they have opportunities to succeed and grow because we know that only together can we do great things.

Our commitment to excellence and innovation has earned us a place on the Forbes Cloud 100 list for ten consecutive years, and we continue to be recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Each of our team members has 5 days set aside as volunteer time off (VTO) to contribute to the communities they live in and give back to the causes they care about most.

What You’ll Get

The annual base salary range for this full-time position is $214,000 to $328,000. This range is an estimate for what Tanium will pay a new hire. The actual annual base salary offered may be adjusted based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, location, education, skills, training, and experience.

In addition to an annual base salary, team members will receive equity awards and a generous benefits package consisting of medical, dental and vision plan, family planning benefits, health savings account, flexible spending account, transportation savings account, 401(k) retirement savings plan with company match, life, accident and disability coverage, business travel accident insurance, employee assistance programs, disability insurance, and other well-being benefits.

Tanium is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, protected Veteran status, or other legally protected categories. If you require a reasonable accommodation in searching for a job opening, completing an application, interviewing, or completing any pre-employment testing or requirements, please contact accommodations@tanium.com. For more information refer to the “Know Your Rights” poster which is available here - https://www.eeoc.gov/poster.

Please be aware of job offers coming from people claiming to be Tanium employees. Tanium employees will only use @tanium.com email addresses to communicate with you, will have video interviews with you, and will never ask you for money.

As the design leader overseeing the entire buyer journey, you'll drive the strategy and execution for everything from customer acquisition, activation, to retention and re-engagement. This includes onboarding, discovery surfaces (browse, search, ranking, personalization, taxonomy), the live shopping experience, customer service, our games team, and customer service flows.

You’ll be a true player-coach, equally comfortable building and developing a high-performing design team as you are rolling up your sleeves and doing the work yourself. You’ll help shape the team, establish clear career paths, mentor designers, and create an environment where people can grow and do their best work.

As a leader, you’ll help define the design strategy and set a clear vision for what our experiences can become, partnering closely with product, engineering, research, and business teams to turn that vision into a roadmap for the team.

As a practitioner, you’ll stay close to the work. You’ll move fluidly from defining the long-term experience vision to tackling specific product and feature-level design challenges - exploring concepts, prototyping ideas, and helping bring the details to life. This role is for someone who can lead through both direction and craft, knowing when to empower the team and when to jump in and design alongside them.

What You'll Do

Lead and scale a high-performing team of product designers across the buyer funnel.
Define and drive the vision, strategy, and execution for the buyer experience in collaboration with cross-functional partners.
Partner with research, data, and product to develop deep customer empathy and inform high-impact design decisions.
Shape intuitive, elegant systems across discovery, live shopping, and post-purchase experiences.
Ensure our experiences are accessible, inclusive, and delightfully human.
Champion design quality and consistency across surfaces while enabling speed and iteration.
Nurture a strong design culture through mentorship, feedback, and high standards for craft and thinking.
Represent design in executive conversations and influence company-wide priorities.

What We’re Looking For

10+ years of product design experience, with at least 3+ years leading teams.
A player-coach mindset-excited to mentor, but equally passionate about designing and solving problems hands-on.
Strong portfolio showcasing interaction and visual design skills, with a track record of shipping successful products.
Proven success designing and scaling customer-facing experiences across a complex funnel (acquisition through retention).
Deep expertise in interaction design, systems thinking, and user-centered design.
Strong understanding of search, discovery, personalization, and taxonomy design principles.
Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, or live shopping platforms is a major plus.
A strong collaborator who thrives at the intersection of product, business, and user needs.
A portfolio that demonstrates thoughtful, elegant solutions to complex problems.

Why You’ll Love This Role

You’ll help define how the next generation of users discover, shop, and engage with sellers and communities they love. You’ll work alongside a passionate and ambitious team that values joy, experimentation, and deep customer empathy. And you’ll help build a design culture where creativity and performance go hand in hand.

If you’re an experienced design leader who loves craft, strategy, and collaboration, we’d love to hear from you!

Reporting Structure

Jon Malkemus - VP of Design

Please note: Whatnot will only contact you through official @whatnot.com email addresses. If you see an email impersonating a Whatnot recruiter, please disregard and report it as spam.

💛 EOE

We value diversity, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, parental status, disability status, or any other status protected by local law. We believe that our work is better and our company culture is improved when we encourage, support, and respect the different skills and experiences represented within our workforce.

new_jobs.title: Vice President, Global Product Strategy
new_jobs.description:
Position Overview:
A senior management role responsible for the company's global product strategy, product portfolio planning, and long-term product growth direction. This position typically reports to the CEO, President, or Chief Product Officer (CPO) and serves as a bridge between various departments, including marketing, customers, product, technology, sales, operations, and finance/investment.

Core Responsibilities
Global Product Strategy
Formulate the company's global product strategy and medium-to-long-term product development roadmaps.
Determine product direction based on global market trends, customer needs, and the competitive landscape.
Establish product strategies tailored to different regions and customer segments.
Product Portfolio Management
Manage the company's overall product portfolio; identify key products, growth products, and strategic products.
Evaluate product lifecycles, market potential, and business value.
Determine strategic directions regarding product entry, expansion, upgrades, or exit.
Market and Competitive Analysis
Continuously research global markets, industry trends, and competitors.
Analyze customer needs, pricing dynamics, market size, and growth opportunities.
Translate market insights into product strategies and business opportunities.
Product Roadmap
Develop annual and multi-year product roadmaps.
Determine priorities for product development, resource allocation, and go-to-market timing.
Coordinate R&D, engineering, design, marketing, and sales teams to execute the strategy.
Global Market Expansion
Participate in product planning for new markets, countries, and business areas.
Formulate localized product strategies based on specific market characteristics.
Support the company's internationalization and global business growth.
Cross-functional Leadership
Collaborate with the CEO, CPO, CTO, CMO, CFO, COO, and regional leaders.
Coordinate resources across product, technology, sales, marketing, operations, and finance functions.
Drive the execution of company-wide strategic initiatives.
Commercialization and Growth
Participate in defining product pricing, business models, and revenue growth strategies.
Identify new revenue streams for products.
Enhance market penetration, customer retention, and product profitability.
Strategic Partnerships and M&A
Evaluate potential partners, technical collaborations, and strategic alliances.
Participate in product-related investment, M&A, and integration projects as necessary.
Assess whether external technologies, products, or companies align with the corporate strategy.
Qualifications
Over 20 years of experience in product management, strategy, business development, or related fields.
Over 8 years of experience in senior management or cross-functional leadership roles. Possesses work experience in global markets or multinational corporations.
Familiar with product strategy, market analysis, business models, and product lifecycle management.
Demonstrates strong capabilities in data analysis, business judgment, and strategic planning.
Capable of communicating at a strategic level with the CEO, the Board of Directors, and senior management.
Possesses excellent cross-functional coordination, negotiation, and leadership skills.

new_jobs.title: Senior Manager, Product Telemetry & Analytics
new_jobs.description:
Meet the Moment with Alteryx

We're living through a once-in-a-generation shift in how work gets done. Data, automation, and AI are quickly becoming the center of every business decision - and Alteryx is leading the transformation.

You'll be working on the challenges that sit at the heart of modern business. No matter your role, the work you do will help organizations move faster, see more clearly, and tackle questions that used to feel impossible.

If you're ready to meet the moment with innovation, curiosity, and excellence, there's a place for you here.

We are hiring a Senior Manager, Product Telemetry & Analytics to lead the team behind how Alteryx understands product usage and customer behavior. Our telemetry function has grown from supporting Product to supporting the company: Finance, Customer Success, Rev Ops, and Sales all depend on this data to make decisions.

You will lead a team based in India that owns instrumentation, the semantic layer, and the self-serve analytics platform that makes product data available across the business. You are accountable for how the function runs: prioritization and capacity, enablement and adoption, team visibility, and talent development.

This role is based on the East Coast to maximize overlap with the team's working hours and reports to the Sr. Director, Customer Signals.

What You'll Do

Own a single intake path for telemetry and analytics requests across Product, Finance, CS, Rev Ops, and IT, balancing planned platform work against urgent executive asks
Partner with technical leadership on feasibility, dependency order, and sequencing
Build enablement into a standing program so each function can find, understand, and trust the data on its own, and grow the share of demand served through self-serve
Govern metric definitions so the same number means the same thing in every forum
Own how the function is represented to leadership: what is shipping, what is blocked, what changed, and what it means, with recommendations rather than status
Lead and develop a team based in India, including talent assessment, performance, career paths, and the skills the function needs as it becomes more AI-native

Success in This Role

The organization self-serves a growing share of its telemetry and analytics needs each quarter
Platform and foundation work advances predictably rather than losing to whoever asked most recently
Leadership knows what the team is working on, what is coming, and what is not yet covered, without asking
Stakeholders trust the numbers, because definitions are aligned and governed
The team grows in strategic capability, and no single person becomes a bottleneck

Who You Are

8+ years in product telemetry, product analytics, analytics engineering, or data roles, including at least 3 years managing a team
Demonstrated ownership of an analytics or data operating model: intake, prioritization, capacity planning, and service expectations
Experience building self-service analytics or internal data products that teams could find, understand, and trust
Track record of executive communication: setting expectations, framing tradeoffs, and earning trust with senior stakeholders
Fluent enough in both product analytics and data architecture to be credible in either conversation, without needing to be the expert in the room
Experience leading a team based outside the U.S., ideally in India, across a significant time zone difference

Bonus Points

Experience with AI-native or agent-queryable data infrastructure
Familiarity with Snowflake, Amplitude, or comparable warehouse and behavioral analytics platforms
Experience in enterprise software with a complex user journey, or in PLG and product adoption environments
Hands-on background in SQL, dbt, or pipeline work, even if not current
Experience working alongside UX research, VOC, or experience measurement functions

Compensation

Alteryx is committed to fair, equitable, and transparent compensation. Final compensation is determined by several factors, including but not limited to relevant work experience, education, certifications, skills, and geographic location.

The base salary range for this role in the United States is $183,125 to $200,450.

This role is also eligible for a target annual bonus of 15% of base salary, based on individual and company performance.

In addition to base pay and bonus eligibility, this role includes clear forms of additional compensation, such as:

A monthly Connectivity Plus stipend of $150 to support remote work-related expenses
An annual $200 home office reimbursement

Alteryx offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial security, and overall well-being, including:

Medical, dental, and vision coverage
401(k) with company match
Paid parental leave, caregiver leave, and flexible time off
Mental health support and wellness reimbursement
Career development and education assistance

new_jobs.title: Director, Product Management - Data Platform
new_jobs.description:
Summary

The Basics:

Our Product Management team is actively seeking a new Director of Product Management focused on Data Platform, Cloud, and SaaS Architecture
to join our passionate, driven, and fast-paced team. In this role, you will own and shape Tanium’s end-to-end data strategy across cloud and SaaS environments, partnering closely with engineering, product, design, and cross-functional leadership to define how Tanium stores, accesses, queries, moves, and visualizes data across the platform.

You will bring deep experience in cloud and SaaS architectures, data platforms, and enterprise-scale systems, with the ability to translate complex customer, product, and technical requirements into actionable strategy and execution. You will need to be successful influencing cross-functionally across all levels of the organization, operating horizontally across multiple teams and pods, and drive clarity in ambiguous, complex technical domains. You must also be comfortable setting strategic direction while staying close enough to the work to make high-quality product and architecture decisions.

This is an individual contributor role.

Responsibilities

Own the product strategy and roadmap for Tanium’s cloud/SaaS data platform, from ideation through launch, in close partnership with engineering teams.
Define and drive the short- and long-term roadmap for Tanium’s end-to-end data architecture, including storage, access, query, visualization, and data movement capabilities.
Partner with Product Managers, Engineering, Design, and leadership across the organization to align priorities across multiple pods and ensure teams are building toward a cohesive data strategy.
Lead product direction for how data is surfaced and experienced in Atlas and the UI, with a focus on improving trust, usability, reliability, and customer value.
Drive the strategy for data movement and integration capabilities, including export, import, and scalable data exchange patterns across products and use cases.
Establish clear product requirements, technical specifications, use cases, business logic, and success metrics for data platform capabilities.
Partner with engineering leadership to make durable architectural decisions across complex, distributed cloud and SaaS systems.
Champion data quality as a core product priority, setting expectations and mechanisms to improve consistency, reliability, and trust throughout the data lifecycle.
Collaborate with internal teams on enablement, training, and launch materials to ensure successful adoption of new data capabilities and platform improvements.
Work closely with business, technical, customer-facing, and go-to-market teams to understand customer needs, solve daily challenges, and identify opportunities for product differentiation.
Leverage innovation and trends in cloud, SaaS, data architecture, analytics, and enterprise platform technologies to develop strategic solutions.

Requirements

Education

BA/BS required
MA/MS or equivalent advanced technical/business degree preferred

Experience

8+ years of total professional experience in enterprise B2B software, with at least 5 years in product management supporting a SaaS, cloud platform, data platform, infrastructure, or security technology product.
Proven experience leading product strategy for complex technical platforms, including the ability to define opportunities, translate customer needs into requirements, and deliver products at enterprise scale.
Deep experience with cloud and SaaS architectures, with strong working knowledge of hyperscaler environments such as Azure and/or AWS.
Strong data platform experience, including one or more of the following:
Data storage and data access architectures
Query layers and large-scale database systems
Data visualization and analytics experiences
Data movement, export/import, integration, or interoperability capabilities
Data quality, reliability, governance, and lifecycle considerations

Experience working across distributed systems and multiple product surfaces, rather than a single narrowly defined application or monolith.
Experience with large-scale enterprise data systems; experience with graph databases is a plus.
Strong track record of working with engineering and business stakeholders to drive product definition, strategic alignment, prioritization, and execution.
Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, quickly ramp into new technical domains, and bring structure to broad, evolving problem spaces.
Proven ability to influence horizontally across cross-functional teams, product pods, and senior stakeholders.
Technology background preferred, ideally with experience in security, systems management, IT operations, cloud infrastructure, data platforms, or enterprise platform products.

Nice to have

Experience with graph databases or graph-based data models.
Experience with large-scale database systems, analytics platforms, or enterprise data visualization products.
Broader hyperscaler depth across Azure, AWS, and/or other cloud providers.
Experience building durable export/import patterns and integrations across complex enterprise products.
Experience leading product teams through organizational growth, hiring, or team structure evolution.

About Tanium

Tanium is the Autonomous IT company. As Al accelerates both innovation and risk, Tanium Atlas, the company's autonomous operating system, puts the full depth of the Tanium Autonomous IT Platform behind every IT and security operator - human and agentic. Tanium provides the real-time intelligence, agentic decision-making, and autonomous execution operators needed to detect, decide, and remediate at machine speed across their endpoint estate.

The company is recognized as a Leader in the inaugural 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Endpoint Management Tools, as a Leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Client Endpoint Management Software for Windows Device Management 2025-2026 Vendor Assessment, and as a Leader in The Forrester Wave™. Endpoint Management Platforms, Q2 2026.

To learn how Tanium delivers Autonomous IT for unstoppable business, visit www.tanium.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

On a mission. Together.

At Tanium, we are stewards of a culture that emphasizes the importance of collaboration, respect, and diversity. In our pursuit of revolutionizing the way some of the largest enterprises and governments in the world solve their most difficult IT challenges, we are strengthened by our unique perspectives and by our collective actions.

As a global organization with stakeholders around the world, it’s imperative that the diversity of our customers and communities is reflected internally in our team members. We strive to create a diverse and inclusive environment where everyone feels they have opportunities to succeed and grow because we know that only together can we do great things.

Our commitment to excellence and innovation has earned us a place on the Forbes Cloud 100 list for ten consecutive years, and we continue to be recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Each of our team members has 5 days set aside as volunteer time off (VTO) to contribute to the communities they live in and give back to the causes they care about most.

What You’ll Get

The annual base salary range for this full-time position is $214,000 to $328,000. This range is an estimate for what Tanium will pay a new hire. The actual annual base salary offered may be adjusted based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, location, education, skills, training, and experience.

In addition to an annual base salary, team members will receive equity awards and a generous benefits package consisting of medical, dental and vision plan, family planning benefits, health savings account, flexible spending account, transportation savings account, 401(k) retirement savings plan with company match, life, accident and disability coverage, business travel accident insurance, employee assistance programs, disability insurance, and other well-being benefits.

Tanium is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, protected Veteran status, or other legally protected categories. If you require a reasonable accommodation in searching for a job opening, completing an application, interviewing, or completing any pre-employment testing or requirements, please contact accommodations@tanium.com. For more information refer to the “Know Your Rights” poster which is available here - https://www.eeoc.gov/poster.

Please be aware of job offers coming from people claiming to be Tanium employees. Tanium employees will only use @tanium.com email addresses to communicate with you, will have video interviews with you, and will never ask you for money.
